    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Athlete
    Represents an athlete participating in the Olympic Games.
    AthleteDAO
    Manages the persistence of athletes in a JSON file.
    ATHLETES_MENU_OPTION
    Defines the available options in the athletes submenu.
    Competition
    Represents a competition in the Olympic Games.
    COMPETITION_FORMAT
    Defines the different formats of competitions in the Olympic Games.
    CompetitionDAO
    Manages the persistence of competitions in JSON and CSV files.
    COMPETITIONS_MENU_OPTION
    Defines the available options in the competition submenu.
    Controller
    Controls the execution of the Olympic Games application.
    Delegation
    Represents a delegation participating in the Olympic Games.
    DelegationDAO
    Manages the persistence of delegations in a JSON file.
    DELEGATIONS_MENU_OPTION
    Defines the available options in the delegations submenu.
    ERROR_TYPE
    Defines the different types of errors that can occur in the system.
    Main
    Entry point of the Olympic Games application.
    MAIN_MENU_OPTION
    Defines the available options in the main menu.
    MessagesEN
    Contains the messages used by the application.
    OlympicsManager
    Manages the business logic of the Olympic Games application.
    PROFILE_TYPE
    Defines the different athlete profiles in the Olympic Games.
    Result
    Represents the results of an Olympic competition.
    UIManager
    Manages the user interface of the Olympic Games application.
    Weight
    Represents the attribute weights of an Olympic competition.
